title: Elon Musk on Joe Rogan denies advanced tech
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Elon Musk on Joe Rogan denies advanced tech, about 2025 at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Now Elon Musk recently said on Joe Rogan he has an all access pass through Lockheed and Northrup and we don't have any of these technologies.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that in 2025 the businessman Elon Musk went on another podcast, hosted by Joe Rogan, and said he has an "all access pass" to the big aerospace and defense companies Lockheed and Northrop. According to Michels, Musk said those companies have none of the secret advanced technologies people talk about. Michels raises it because it pushes back on the idea that defense contractors are quietly holding craft that aren't of human origin.
